smokeActions.evidence: click Just notify me when paid plans open
click Join the waitlist (nth:1 band link)
click Pricing after scroll to Back to blog (viewport footer row)

expected14_hits_7d.hogql: WITH ids AS (SELECT arrayJoin(['hero_ebooks','hero_waitlist_anchor','hero_waitlist_inline_notify','hero_prompt_studio','hero_signup','band_contact','hero_pricing','header_nav_pricing','header_nav_blog','band_waitlist','blog_post_footer_waitlist','blog_post_footer_pricing','pricing_card_monthly','pricing_card_annual']) AS expected) SELECT i.expected AS cta_id, countIf(e.properties.cta_id = i.expected AND e.timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS hits_7d FROM ids i LEFT JOIN events e ON e.event = 'elevate_marketing_cta_click' GROUP BY i.expected ORDER BY i.expected

elevate_marketing_cta_click_total.hogql: SELECT count() AS total FROM events WHERE event = 'elevate_marketing_cta_click'

verdict.notes: Prior HogQL GROUP BY toString(properties.cta_id) omitted band_waitlist/blog_post_footer_* in UI-style result set; raw properties.cta_id + allowlist join shows 14/14 hits_7d ≥ 1.
